findings.title: /live answers in 11.5 s against a 1.0 s budget
findings.detail: First staged /live probe returns in 11.5 s; the gate budget is 1.0 s.

findings.title: STT model missing from the bundle — masked by the dev machine's global cache
findings.detail: A clean install has no STT model on disk; dev runs passed only because a machine-wide model cache filled the gap.

findings.title: VAD fetched from the network at runtime, shipped model unused
findings.detail: The offline run downloads the VAD model at startup while the bundled copy sits unused.

waits_on_human.title: Bundle the STT model (~500 MB) or download on first run?
waits_on_human.why: Determines what D-2's fix looks like: ship the model inside the installer or add a first-run fetch.
